description: Full-text search one inbox's mail — subject, sender, and reply text — best match first. Use it to find an earlier conversation ("the invoice from Acme") before replying or to check whether something already arrived. Words match exactly (no stemming), so search for distinctive terms. Messages held by the security scan are excluded.

q.description: Words to find; wrap a phrase in double quotes to match it exactly.

name: volanea_search_inbox

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
